items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: D'Antoni is mentioned as the owner of the boxing club/venue where the interviewee played with Jumbo, but no direct personal interaction or professional relationship between the interviewee and D'Antoni is described.

ctx.x: So you would play with Jumbo through the 50s then, huh?

Well, when Jumbo left, WWL if you remember that, I was playing with him then. No, I don't remember it. Because he signed up with, with, with, uh, Vicar, well, D'Antoni, when he opened up that place on, when he opened up that boxing club there that's on St. Charles and Poitras.
You know which club he's talking about, Dick? Curly's?
